episodes.title: The Psychology of Cults: Why Smart People Join & Can't Leave
episodes.description: Nobody joins a cult. They join a community that finally gets them. Dr. Nika breaks down the exact psychological playbook high-control groups use to recruit normal, intelligent people, & why leaving feels like destroying everything that matters. Music from YouTube Audio Library: At Depth by Lish Grooves #CultPsychology #LoveBombing #MindControl
